payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: (corroboration from research.29 lead, undirected task relations research) The data-loss case this epic targets is reproducible at the Bob level. A read-only probe 'bob capture-complete -f json --cursor 49' on the leading-run draft '~sase:ref-athena-apollo-operational-log-audit|"see Fix it' (installed bob built after bcc201fe) returned context relation_label, replacement range {start:45,end:57} covering through the end of the draft, and typed candidate '|see'. Meanwhile CapturePanelModel.insertRelationLabelReplacement (bob-mac-capture bf30f9e, :6695-6702) replaces token end through draft end, and the label probe splices '|"typed' before the tail (:6740-6754). Accepting a label for '~sase:x Fix it' would therefore drop ' Fix it'. Please cover leading-run tokens and a modifier after the token ('Fix it ~a:b &c:d') in aj.2's tests. Details: research:202610/undirected_task_relations/undirected_task_relations__final.md section 8.
